Good to know

Common questions.

What is the price range?

PKR 700 – 2,500 depending on the collection and design. The simple Name Tote starts at PKR 700, and a fully custom "Make Your Own" goes up to PKR 2,500. The final quote is always confirmed on WhatsApp before we start.

How long does delivery take?

5 working days after design approval — delivered across the University of Kamalia and nearby areas.

What can I customize?

Everything: your name or initials, favourite quotes, floral/art illustrations, photo collages (Memory), or a full mix of everything in "Make Your Own".

Do I approve the design first?

Yes — always. You receive a design preview and the final price on WhatsApp, and production starts only after your approval.

How do I order?

Tap any "Order" button or fill the order form above — WhatsApp opens with your order pre-filled to +92 304 8316414. Zulkaif replies personally.

How does payment work?

Payment details are confirmed directly with Zulkaif on WhatsApp when you place the order — simple and transparent, no hidden charges.

Can I return a customized bag?

Every bag is made just for you after your design approval. If there is ever a printing defect on our side, message us on WhatsApp — we will make it right.

⚙️ Owner setup — Supabase connection guide (tap to open)
1. Open index.html and find the SUPABASE CONFIG block inside <script> (search for "SUPABASE_URL").
2. Paste your Project URL and anon public key from Supabase → Settings → API.
3. Run this SQL in Supabase → SQL Editor (creates the orders table): 
create table if not exists tote_tales_orders (
  id bigint generated by default as identity primary key,
  created_at timestamptz default now(),
  customer_name text,
  customer_phone text,
  customer_area text,
  collection text,
  custom_text text,
  canvas_color text,
  notes text
);
alter table tote_tales_orders enable row level security;
create policy "allow anon insert" on tote_tales_orders
  for insert to anon with check (true);
Done! Keys paste karne ke baad orders WhatsApp ke saath-saath database mein bhi save honge. Jab tak keys khaali hain — sirf WhatsApp par orders aate hain, aur website 100% normal chalti hai.
